name: Elude Grasp
body:
You have learned to use your slimy skin and retractable body to help you escape from enemies that are trying to grapple you.

Prerequisite: Zif.

Benefit: You gain a +2 racial bonus on your CMD. This does not stack with your other racial modifiers that affect your CMD.

Remarkable Races: Compendium of Unusual PC Races, Pathway to Adventure Edition. Copyright 2009, Alluria Publishing; Author: J. Matthew Kubisz
